# Environment that actually produced every result in exploration/.

# Recorded from the interpreter used for the 2026-10-27 rebuild (see
# exploration/MANIFEST.md, which carries the SHA-256 of every generated file).
# This is deliberately NOT the upstream 2019 pinned environment (Python 3.7,
# h5py 2.8.0, numpy 1.22): upstream's BuildPkl_Batch*.ipynb notebooks use the
# `h5py.Dataset.value` API, which was removed in h5py 3.0, and nothing in
# exploration/ can run under it.

#   Python      3.13.5  (CPython)
#   HDF5        2.0.0   (bundled with h5py 3.16.0)
#   platform    Linux-6.12.107+deb13-amd64-x86_64-with-glibc2.41
#
# Set up with:
#   python3.13 -m venv .venv
#   .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
